notes: Repricing: the scan files every card to the cloud up front and listens, so a card the box is still working never freezes the scan or fails for time, and the scan label counts down as answers land. The card panel's one-card refresh asks the cloud live first and only queues when it cannot answer. In cloud mode the PC never runs its own eBay scrape. Slabs: Reload photos always asks PSA, CGC or BGS again, refuses a stale cached row, and says what happened for the front and the back instead of silent success.
